en: Sepia-toned street scene showing an early 20th‑century urban avenue with tram tracks and two trams, cyclists, and pedestrians. Tall trees line the street and brick townhouses with bay windows and shutters stand on the right. The printed caption at the bottom left reads "NIJMEGEN. Hunerpark" with the word "Hunerpark" struck through, and handwritten text underneath reads "st. Jorisstraat."
